title: Human Resources
subtitle: People, schedules and development in one place.
draftHelp: Drafts stay only on this screen and are lost when leaving or reloading. They do not change official payroll, attendance or records.
subject: Title / reference
empty: No official records connected in this area.
invalid: Check the fields and date order.
prepared: Draft prepared in this session. It was not sent to the server.
reportHelp: Official reports, charts, Excel and PDF require HR records and are not connected yet.
securityHelp: Roles and permissions use existing controls. HR audit, backup and signatures await integration; no legal processing occurs here.
subjectPlaceholder: E.g. vacancy, shift, pay period or document

descriptions.overview: View the real team and organize HR processes.
descriptions.recruitment: Vacancies, resumes, screening, interviews, assessments and offers.
descriptions.lifecycle: Documents, exams, contracts, signatures and departure checklists.
descriptions.attendance: Clock-in/out, breaks, justifications, time bank and attendance records.
descriptions.schedules: Shifts, swaps, days off, on-call duty and hours by role.
descriptions.leave: Vacation planning, leave and medical certificates.
descriptions.payroll: Salary, additions, commissions, deductions, annual bonus and payslips. No calculation or payment in this interface.
descriptions.benefits: Transport, meals, health and cost per benefit.
descriptions.compliance: Obligation checklists, employment documents, exams and safety. No official submission in this interface.
descriptions.performance: Goals, feedback, reviews, training and workplace climate.
descriptions.reports: Team, turnover, payroll, absence, overtime and due dates.
descriptions.portal: Requests, announcements, profile updates and signature documents.
descriptions.security: Roles, restricted data, audit, backup and retention.

switchConfirm: Switch areas and discard the unfinished form?
